port_policy: MOS all six port pairs including bulk; balun first-port star; other devices all port pairs; tied ports retain self-loops
graph_scope: DUT primitives; external fixture/load/feedback bindings recorded explicitly, not merged into DUT nets

message_passing.normalization_note: Optional structural weights, including retained typed self-loops. Not automatically applied by a model.

hierarchy_scope: flattened source netlist; top-level depth zero
message_edge_policy: Two typed orientations per physical port pair, including tied-port self-loops; not an inferred signal-flow direction
feature_transform_policy: Raw SI retained; log10 positive W/L/R/C/L/ratio, log2 positive m/nf; zero gets a separate flag; no fitted normalization
